name: Nazir
source:
The second prince, Nazir, has no interest for the crown - and neither for the court. You will often find him hanging in the town instead of fulfilling his responsabilities.
With a rather free-spirited and irresponsible nature, Nazir is unpopular among the aristocrats.

Flirtarious and always trying to sweep you off your feet - his flippant personality often hides how he truly cares for the nation and its people.
